sloka: सत्यमेवेश्वरो लोके सत्यं पद्मा श्रिता सदा ।सत्यमूलानि सर्वाणि सत्यान्नास्ति परं पदम् ॥ २.१०९.१३॥
transliteration: satyameveśvaro loke satyaṁ padmā śritā sadā ।satyamūlāni sarvāṇi satyānnāsti paraṁ padam ॥ 2.109.13॥

translations.english: Truth is God. The goddess of wealth always takes refuge in truth. Truth is the root of everything. It is supreme and there is nothing above it.
translations.hindi: श्रीराम से भरत जी की, की की हुई प्राथना सुन, सब नगर" चासी साधु साधु कहने लगे
